audienceHypothesis: People coordinating important accounts and documents with family or different trusted people
cadence: One useful scenario and one short product demonstration per week after launchable product and channel authorization

pillars.hook: Could someone you trust find the right starting point?
pillars.asset: Synthetic map, one location, one next action
pillars.claimGate: Never display an actual person's plan or account number

pillars.asset: Synthetic A/B/C with separate visible items
pillars.claimGate: Matches latest tested ACL and revocation behavior; no guarantee about downloaded copies

pillars.hook: Start with where it is, not your passwords.
pillars.asset: Provider name, document location, official next step
pillars.claimGate: No claim of zero knowledge, end-to-end encryption or legal authority

pillars.hook: Ask someone to check the information they can actually see.
pillars.claimGate: Label staging demo while launch closed; no claim of delivered reminders

pillars.hook: Sharing should stay a choice you can change.
pillars.asset: Allowed live access followed by revoked state
pillars.claimGate: Only current app access is revoked; previously obtained copies cannot be recalled

pillars.hook: Start with one important item and one trusted person.
pillars.asset: Public page to explicit private save intent
pillars.claimGate: No false urgency, fabricated testimonial, readiness score or guaranteed outcome

rules: No unsolicited DMs or automated public replies
No fake engagement, testimonials or fear-based death countdowns
Source product claims from current specs and evidence
Store content assets and drafts outside private user data
No optional tracking until consent and opt-out controls are ready
